text:
Sara: Clearing out my SF desk — free to pick up on Friday: two 27" Dell P2719H monitors (excellent condition, one tiny bezel scratch), and a dual Ergotron LX monitor arm (full-motion). Also throwing in a DisplayPort cable and VESA adapter. Pickup at Market St office between 3–6pm. DM to claim. Photos: https://imgur.com/a/xyz123
Omar: Condition on the panels? Any dead pixels or backlight bleed?
Sara: No dead pixels, tested at 1440p for a few hours yesterday. Minimal backlight, nothing visible in normal use. :thumbsup:
Jules: Are the arms VESA 75/100 compatible? I might take just the arm if monitors go first.
Sara: Yep VESA 75/100 supported, and the arm has desk-clamp and grommet mount. I can include the Allen keys.
Mika: I’ll take the monitors — do you want them picked up together? I can bring a car.
Noah: I can swing by at 4:30 and grab the arm if it’s still available.
Sara: Thanks! Marking monitors as held for Mika, arm tentatively Noah. Mika — can you confirm pickup time? :raised_hands:
Mika: Confirmed 3:45pm pickup. I’ll message with my phone.
LogisticsBot: Reminder — building visitor sign-in required after 5pm; after-hours pickup not allowed. https://intra/redwood/office-hours
Omar: If anything falls through I’m nearby and can collect later today.
Sara: Cool, I’ll DM you if plans change. Thanks everyone! :coffee:
